platform: Both (Web spec below; mobile Bottom-Sheet curriculum variant not built)

conflicts.description: The showcase's own caption over-states its Course Player exception as 'the one documented exception to authenticated sidebar navigation,' which reads as 'no sidebar at all.' The authoritative ux/SCREEN_UX_SPECS.md § 10 says the Sidebar is 'collapsed by default,' not removed.
conflicts.resolution: shared/navigation.json#/shells/coursePlayerShell is the locked rule: COLLAPSE to 72px icon-only, never full removal. This spec's `shell` field points there and must not be reinterpreted by any generic AppShell mapping.

layout.$description: LOCKED two-column desktop layout, restructured in D49 from an earlier single-column/no-tabs implementation (55% fidelity at the time).
topBar: course title + "Lesson N of M · X% complete"
contentColumn: Overview | Resources tabs (exactly these two — no Notes/Discussion, both Post-MVP)
AI Tutor entry (now in top bar, not inline)
curriculumColumn: section/lesson list with per-lesson completion Badge, current lesson highlighted

content: VideoPlayer 16:9 — loading skeleton / inline error+retry on failure
section headings (h3) + lesson rows with completion Badge

artworkRules: n/a — video content, no course-thumbnail artwork on this screen.

states.error: inline error sized to video frame, icon+title+retry
states.completion: not a separate screen state — routes to Quiz or an inline completion confirmation (see quiz-results.json)

rtlBehavior: top bar, tabs, Previous/Next row, curriculum panel all mirror (curriculum moves to logical-start/left side in RTL). LOCKED EXCEPTION: the VideoPlayer scrubber/timeline NEVER mirrors, regardless of app layout direction — verified live in Arabic/RTL during D49 browser verification (video-player.tsx's dir="ltr" on the scrubber, untouched).
themeBehavior: video control bar tokens (color.overlay.scrim, color.text.inverse) are deliberately theme-invariant by design — not a hardcoded-color violation, see shared/components.json#/videoPlayer
responsiveRules: shared/responsive.json#/perSurfaceRules/coursePlayer — two-column desktop+, single-column + BottomSheet curriculum below desktop (BottomSheet variant not built, Web-only implementation to date)
knownGaps: Video-control chrome's visual polish against real footage could not be fully re-verified in D49 because the seeded lesson's video asset does not play in this dev environment — a pre-existing, unrelated media/backend limitation.
